counting_rule: Count captured result cards and seed records as occurrences; deduplicate to canonical works by DOI/report identity, exact normalized title, and version relationship.
main_corpus_rule: Do not add foundational theory sources to the final 222-study main CUA corpus; retain them as a separate evidence route.
limitations: Search-card counts are not search-engine total-hit counts.
The branch is targeted and theory-family driven, not an exhaustive history-of-security bibliography.
Selection was performed by the author; no independent second screener was used.
Only included sources received local full-text hashing and exact locator verification in this package.
